sources.title: Scouting Jets kicker Younghoe Koo
sources.description: Over the next few months, we’re breaking down all of the undrafted free agents signed by the Jets since April’s draft. However, today we are focusing on a recent veteran addition; kicker Younghoe Koo. The 31-year old Koo is listed at 5’9″ and 185 pounds and was undrafted out of Georgia Southern in 2017. After […]
